decisions.reason: The Hero V remains the accent's derivation source. Refining the Hero V arm and vertex relationship does not change the accent's derivation rule or geometric-consistency requirement.

The closing V remains derived from the evolving Hero V geometry. The source changes the Hero V design direction but does not alter the closing V's derivation rule or shared-characteristics requirement.
The source addresses only exploration of the Hero V's arms and vertex. It does not resume or change the deferred E and L letterform requirements.
The references to sculptural expression and avoiding decoration concern Hero V geometry, not the deferred champagne material treatment.
The source does not change the closing V's smaller, subordinate prominence relative to the Hero V.
Exploration of the Hero V's arm and vertex geometry does not change or resume the deferred full-wordmark kerning requirement.
The source provides design feedback on the Hero V and does not change acceptable proof formats or file-viewability requirements.
